description: AccessProof certifier: the ONLY production write path (certificate imports / route attestation; production verifies signatures against the pinned certifier key).

runCommand: [ "$SELF" = "i-0c11427d4d9c1b438" ] || { echo "REFUSED: document pinned to i-0c11427d4d9c1b438 (running on $SELF)" >&2; exit 2; }
OP='{{ operation }}'; ORG='{{ organizationId }}'; APP='{{ applicationId }}'
printf '%s' "{{ payload1 }}{{ payload2 }}{{ payload3 }}{{ payload4 }}{{ payload5 }}{{ payload6 }}{{ payload7 }}{{ payload8 }}" | base64 -d > "$F"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert isinstance(d, dict)' "$F" || { echo "PAYLOAD_NOT_JSON_OBJECT" >&2; exit 3; }

echo '' | base64 -d | docker exec -i -e PYTHONPATH=/app accessproof-api-1 python - import --record /tmp/ap-record.json; rc=$?
route_certificate_import) docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api python scripts/remote_route_certificate.py import --organization-id "$ORG" --application-id "$APP" < "$F" ;;
route_attestation) docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api python scripts/remote_route_certificate.py attest --organization-id "$ORG" --application-id "$APP" < "$F" ;;
